qwen_voices.C: Male, 50 years old, American airline captain. Low, calm, flat intercom voice, slow and bored.

lines.text: What if you never stopped? Not for one single second.
Hour one. You burned a hundred calories. That's one cookie.
Day one. You lost two liters of water. You're a raisin now.
Day three. Your wrist files for divorce.
Week one. Friction wins. Friction always wins.
Plus, after round one, your body forces a cooldown. Science says: no.
So you'd just be sitting there. Forever.
Then your mom opens the door.
